recreation_prompts.t2i_start_frame: A breathtaking aerial drone perspective gliding low over a dense East Asian financial district waterfront at golden hour, approximately three seconds into a wide establishing shot. The architectural subject is a dense forest of glass and steel skyscrapers that rise dramatically from a coastal urban landscape. The leftmost tower dominates the left third of the frame in extreme close oblique view, its full-height glass curtain-wall facade reflecting warm amber clouds and a flaring sun low on the horizon behind it. Behind this foreground tower, five to eight additional high-rise towers recede in diagonal perspective toward the right background, each one catching orange, amber, and gold tones against a backlit hazy sky, their edges glowing with rim-light halos produced by the strong backlighting. A multilane elevated highway curves along the base of the towers, busy with tiny vehicles rendered small by the massive architectural scale above them, the road infrastructure of the city visible as a grey ribbon curving through the urban density. Beyond the highway, a working harbor stretches across the middle distance with cargo vessels, utility boats, and commercial shipping infrastructure sitting still on the water, the ocean surface shimmering in diffuse golden light and atmospheric haze created by the warm low-angle sun. A low mountain range silhouette closes the right background, its profile softened against the warm backlit sky, the mountains receding in atmospheric perspective behind the urban infrastructure. The sky itself occupies the upper quarter of the frame, graduating from deep warm amber and burnt orange at the horizon through pale hazy blue-white toward the frame top, with delicate cirrus cloud wisps catching direct sunlight and appearing almost luminous against the blue field above them. The overall mood is of immense urban scale, prosperity, institutional authority, and the confidence of capital — a great financial city at the very peak of its golden hour. Lighting is fully backlit with the sun positioned low on the horizon at approximately 3200K warm color temperature, creating an 8:1 key-to-fill ratio that renders the tower facades in deep shadow on their camera-facing side while producing a brilliant golden halo rim light along every tower edge and building silhouette that gives the skyline its dramatic graphic quality. Lens choice is long telephoto compression at approximately 200-400mm equivalent, causing the towers to visually stack together and compress the spatial distance between layers of urban density into a dense architectural tapestry of glass and steel. Subtle heat haze and atmospheric depth create slight halation between tower layers, softening each successive background layer progressively and adding cinematic depth to the composition. Color palette: #D4820A dominant amber sky, #F5B83C sun flare and halo accent highlight, #2B3A5A tower shadow face deep blue, #87A4C1 harbor midtone water cool reflective, #1A1A1A deep shadow at tower bases and road surface. Primary texture is polished high-reflectance glass curtain-wall panels with minimal fine grain catching the warm backlighting; secondary textures include asphalt road surface below and matte slightly ruffled ocean water extending to the horizon. Post-processing signature: cinematic color grade with orange-teal color split typical of Korean broadcast commercial advertising, slightly desaturated shadows, boosted highlight warmth in the amber tones, barely perceptible fine film grain added in post-production for cinematic quality. No people are visible anywhere in the frame — this is purely architectural spectacle conveying institutional power, scale, and the world of traditional incumbent banking under implicit critique.
